naming_evidence: schemas/tools/video_stitch.schema.json pip_margin = {type integer, minimum 0, "Margin in pixels for PiP overlay from edges"} - the repository's only margin precedent. Qualifier+margin naming, integer, minimum 0, video-space pixels. A distinct name from the native ASS margin_v was required because the resolver flattens canonical and native keys into one dict.
precedence: defaults(40) -> playbook -> canonical vertical_margin -> explicit native margin_v
doc_finding: skills/pipelines/talking-head/compose-director.md:179 advises "On a 1920-high frame ... MarginV=160" as if MarginV were frame pixels. Against the real 288-line PlayRes that is ~1067px from the edge - mid-frame. The canonical vertical_margin now makes that guidance expressible correctly; the doc line itself is left unmodified (out of scope).
